task: Serve the cached search results for the product catalog. Token budget is nearly exhausted by prior context.

candidate_memories.content: Cached search results must be invalidated before serving if the catalog version in the cache header does not match the current catalog_version in the metadata store. Serving stale results after a catalog update causes incorrect availability information to be shown to customers, resulting in failed orders.
Catalog version is stored in Redis at key catalog:version; check on every cache read before serving.
Cache invalidation must be synchronous with catalog updates; do not use TTL-based expiry as the sole invalidation mechanism for catalog data.
